[C107 · daily · Talia Finch] The Oaks' Groundswell in Downtown As I stepped off the BART train at the Downtown station, the crisp air carried the whispers of excitement about the Oakland Oaks. I made my way to a corner store on Broadway, where I found Jessie Hess, a local resident, sipping on a coffee. "I can feel the energy around Downtown, people are really excited about the Oaks' upcoming season, it's all anyone can talk about when they come in for their coffee," she said, her eyes sparkling with enthusiasm.
